description: Phase 3: creates ONE semantic relationship plus its view connection as a single undo/redo step. A relationship is always paired with a connection in the target view (a view renders edges from its connections only, so an unpaired relationship would vanish on reload). The forward batch (add_relationship + set_view_connection) goes through the shared ModelingOperationEngine, so the notation rules provider judges the new flow exactly as modeling_apply_operations does; Undo is a lossless rollback of what the command added.
